dt: Abstracts required (abstract deadline extended by Amendment 01 of Oct 27, 2026); full proposals due Dec 18, 2026, 1:00 pm ET (DARPA-PS-26-141)
e: Funds new ways to synthesize polymers and nonlinear optical materials with molecular-level control, with sub-nanosecond electro-optic modulators as the target application. It suits teams that combine synthesis, computation, characterization, microfabrication and photonics; universities can take part.
n: DARPA: Atomically Precise Molecules (APM) – precision polymers and nonlinear optical materials
unv: The APM program page no longer shows a deadline. The SAM.gov notice for DARPA-PS-26-141 (Amendment 01, posted Oct 27, 2026) gives a response date of Dec 18, 2026, 1:00 pm ET and says abstracts are required; the extended abstract date was not seen. DARPA's APM Q&A confirms Other Transaction agreements and that non-US organizations may not take part.
